name: SQLFluff MCP Server
description: Lint, fix, and parse SQL via SQLFluff over the Model Context Protocol, honoring project .sqlfluff/pyproject.toml config.
author: Guy Swartwood

tools.name: lint_file
tools.description: Lint a SQL file on disk, honoring any .sqlfluff / pyproject.toml config discovered by walking up from the file's directory.

tools.name: fix_file
tools.description: Fix a SQL file on disk, honoring discovered .sqlfluff config, optionally writing the result back.

tools.name: parse_file
tools.description: Parse a SQL file on disk and return its parse tree, honoring discovered config.

tools.name: lint_sql
tools.description: Lint a raw SQL string using an explicitly specified dialect.

tools.name: fix_sql
tools.description: Fix a raw SQL string using an explicitly specified dialect and return the cleaned SQL.

tools.name: parse_sql
tools.description: Parse a raw SQL string using an explicitly specified dialect and return its parse tree.

tools.name: list_dialects
tools.description: List the SQL dialects SQLFluff supports (for use with lint_sql / fix_sql / parse_sql).

tools.name: clear_config_cache
tools.description: Clear SQLFluff's internal config-file cache, so edits to .sqlfluff/pyproject.toml made after the server started are picked up.
